# PHP API

Read a Loom index as typed objects. Each snippet runs in the test suite against a small order app; the output below it is what it printed. Fields mirror the [schema](schema.md) in camelCase.

<!-- generated:php-api:quickstart -->
<!-- Generated by `just docs-generate`; edit the source, not this block. -->

## Load an index

```php
use Lucasp\Loom\Index\IndexLoader;

$index = (new IndexLoader)->fromFile('storage/loom/index.json');

echo $index->schemaVersion, "\n";
echo count($index->events()), ' events, ', count($index->routes()), " routes\n";
```

```text title="Output"
1.0
4 events, 2 routes
```

## Look up an entry

```php
$listener = $index->findListener('App\Listeners\SendReceipt');

echo "{$listener->file}:{$listener->line}\n";
echo $listener->registration->value, "\n";

var_dump($index->findListener('App\Listeners\Missing'));
```

```text title="Output"
app/Listeners/SendReceipt.php:9
discovery_unverified
NULL
```

## Walk the graph

```php
$event = 'App\Events\OrderPlaced';

foreach ($index->dispatchersOf($event) as $site) {
    echo "dispatched from {$site->method}\n";
}

foreach ($index->handlersOf($event) as $handler) {
    echo "handled by {$handler->listener}::{$handler->method}\n";

    foreach ($index->findListener($handler->listener)?->dispatches ?? [] as $dispatch) {
        echo "  dispatches {$dispatch->kind->value} {$dispatch->target}\n";
    }
}
```

```text title="Output"
dispatched from App\Http\Controllers\OrderController::store
handled by App\Listeners\SendReceipt::handle
  dispatches event App\Events\ReceiptSent
  dispatches job App\Jobs\SendMail
```

## Handle errors

```php
use Lucasp\Loom\Index\IndexLoader;
use Lucasp\Loom\Index\IndexLoadException;

try {
    (new IndexLoader)->fromJson('{"schema_version": "2.0"}');
} catch (IndexLoadException $e) {
    echo $e->getMessage(), "\n";
}
```

```text title="Output"
Loom index uses schema 2.0, newer than the supported 1.0. Upgrade laravel-loom, or re-run `php artisan loom:scan` with the installed version.
```

## Public classes

Only these classes carry `@api`; everything else is `@internal` and may change in any release.

### `Lucasp\Loom\Index`

| Class | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| `Confidence` | Resolution confidence emitted on `dispatches[*].confidence` and carried on dispatch sites: how sure the scanner is that a dispatch target was resolved correctly. |
| `DispatchKinds` | The kind of a dispatch target, on `dispatches[*].kind`. |
| `DispatchMode` | How a dispatch site executes, recorded on the optional `mode` of `$defs/dispatchSite`. |
| `FrequencyUnit` | The unit of a sub-minute scheduling frequency, emitted on `scheduled_tasks[*].frequency.unit`. |
| `Index` | Immutable Loom index and the stable, documented consumption surface. |
| `IndexLoadException` | Thrown by `IndexLoader` when a Loom index cannot be read, decoded, or structurally recognised as an index payload. |
| `IndexLoader` | Hydrates an `Index` from a Loom index JSON document, the inverse of `Index::toArray()`. |
| `ListenerRegistration` | How a listener registration was discovered, emitted on `listeners[*].registration` and `closure_listeners[*].registration`. |
| `ObserverRegistration` | How an observer registration was discovered, emitted on `observers[*].registration`. |
| `ScheduleKind` | The kind of work a scheduled entry runs, emitted on `scheduled_tasks[*].kind`: an artisan command, a queued/dispatched job, an inline closure, or a shell command via `exec()`. |

### `Lucasp\Loom\Index\Model`

| Class | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| `ClosureListener` | An anonymous (closure) listener bound to an event, with its source span and what it dispatches. |
| `Dispatch` | A resolved dispatch edge: a source (listener, observer, job, route, …) dispatches `target` of a given `kind` from a source location. |
| `DispatchOverrides` | Fluent modifiers applied at a dispatch site (e.g. `->onQueue('high')`, `->delay(60)`, `->afterCommit()`). |
| `DispatchSite` | A source location that dispatches an event, sends a mailable, or notifies a notification. |
| `Event` | A discovered event class, with the sites that dispatch it and the listeners that handle it. |
| `Frequency` | A sub-minute scheduling frequency such as `everyTenSeconds`, emitted on `scheduled_tasks[*].frequency` in place of a cron expression. |
| `Handle` | An event-to-method binding declared by a class listener, emitted on `listeners[*].handles`. |
| `Handler` | A listener-and-method that handles an event, emitted on `events[*].handled_by`. |
| `Job` | A queueable/dispatchable job: its queue configuration, the sites that dispatch it, and what it dispatches in turn. |
| `Listener` | A class listener: the events/methods it handles, how it was registered, and what it dispatches. |
| `Mailable` | A mailable class: its queue configuration and the sites that send it. |
| `ModelEvent` | An Eloquent model lifecycle event (e.g. `created`, `saving`) and the observers/listeners that handle it. |
| `ModelEventHandler` | A handler (observer hook or `Event::listen` target) attached to a model event, emitted on `model_events[*].handled_by`. |
| `Notification` | A notification class: its queue configuration, the channels it sends on, and the sites that notify it. |
| `Observer` | A model observer: the model it observes, which lifecycle hooks it defines, and what it dispatches. |
| `QueueConfig` | Static queue configuration read off a queueable class (job, mailable, notification): `$connection`, `$queue`, `$delay`, `$tries`, `$timeout`, `$backoff`, and whether the class dispatches after the transaction commits. |
| `Route` | An HTTP route: its verb, URI, name, controller target, middleware, and what the action dispatches. |
| `ScheduledTask` | A scheduled task (command, job, closure, or shell exec) with its cron expression or sub-minute `frequency` and its modifiers. |
| `UnresolvedDispatch` | A dispatch site the scanner could not statically resolve to a target, with the raw expression and the reason. |
| `UnresolvedRoute` | A route form the scanner could not read in full, with the source it saw and the reason. |
